model.description: Synthetic smooth colored continuous-measurement sensitivity study; not sampled white sensor noise.
model.coefficient_process: eta(t)=sigma/sqrt(8)*sum_k[A_k cos(2pi f_k t)+B_k sin(2pi f_k t)], independent standard Gaussian A_k,B_k
model.seed_rule: NumPy SeedSequence([base_seed, trial_id, stream]); streams camera=1, gyro=2, accel=3, initialization=99; all 20 camera paths drawn before subset selection
model.paired_design: Same coefficient paths and initial draws across landmark counts and noise levels; high scales nominal coefficients by4.
model.initialization: Recovery: independent delta_v~N(0,3^2 I),delta_g~N(0,1.5^2 I),delta_theta~N(0,(15deg)^2 I); Rhat0=Exp(delta_theta^x)R0; vhat_B0=R0^T(v0+delta_v); ghat_B0=R0^T(g+delta_g). Matched: all deltaszero. p0=phat0=0 in both.
model.position_note: Raw position comparison with no alignment. Matched full-state initialization fixes the initial gauge; recovery position is gauge-dependent and is not claimed to converge tozero.
model.excitation_note: Displayed PE uses noise-free true geometry, not noise-filled measured coefficients. Finite-window positivity does not prove all-time PE.
model.bands_note: Empirical pointwise 5th/50th/95th percentiles across independent trials within each condition; not confidence intervals or Riccati covariance.
model.position_summary_note: Time RMS uses sqrt(trapezoid(position_error_norm^2,time)/duration) per trial; maximum uses stored output times. Percentiles are then taken across trials. A small endpoint error on a loop does not imply accurate odometry.
